import { customizeTable } from "@rebasepro/cms";
import type { customer } from "../../../backend/schema/customer";

export const customerCms = customizeTable<typeof customer>("customer", {
    icon: "Users",
    display: {
        title: "firstName"
    },
    listFields: ["customerId", "firstName", "lastName", "email", "phone", "state"],
    fieldOrder: [
        "customerId",
        "firstName",
        "lastName",
        "email",
        "phone",
        "state",
        "company",
        "address",
        "city",
        "country",
        "postalCode",
        "fax",
        "supportRep"
    ]
});
